title: 3844. Longest Almost-Palindromic Substring

examples.explanation: Choose the substring "abca". Remove "abca". The string becomes "aba", which is a palindrome. Therefore, "abca" is almost-palindromic.
Choose the substring "abba". Remove "abba". The string becomes "aba", which is a palindrome. Therefore, "abba" is almost-palindromic.
Choose the substring "zzabba". Remove "zabba". The string becomes "abba", which is a palindrome. Therefore, "zabba" is almost-palindromic.
